items.title: Edge Aware ASCII Art Conversion
items.prompt: Apply an ASCII-art rendering effect to the reference image, where the ASCII character density and placement is driven by the underlying tonal contrast and edges of the photo, like a true edge-aware ASCII-art conversion. Dense character clusters follow the natural contours, silhouette lines, and high-detail areas (such as hair strands, fabric folds, and background structure), while flatter, low-contrast areas (such as smooth skin) stay comparatively clean with minimal or no texture. The effect should look like the ASCII characters are tracing the actual shapes and edges present in the photo, not a uniform overlay pasted on top of everything equally. Use a classic {argument name="color scheme" default="green-on-black or grayscale"} terminal character set ({argument name="character set" default="@ # % & * + . :"}), {argument name="density" default="medium"} overall density, with the original photo still legible underneath.

items.title: Cinematic Concept Art for Ancient Abandoned Jungle City
items.prompt: ONE-CLICK GENERIC MASTER PROMPT — ANCIENT JUNGLE MORNING STYLE High-end cinematic stylized-realism digital concept art, AAA environment keyframe illustration, film matte-painting depth construction, professional game environment rendering, minimal line art, value-driven form separation, painted edges, controlled edge hierarchy, large-to-small mass construction, clean gradient digital color blending, hybrid hand-painted procedural texture, macro readability prioritized with selective micro-detail in focal structures, studio-quality composition, polished senior-level production finish. SUBJECT / SCENE In an Ancient Jungle Morning Setting, a long-abandoned jungle city plaza with cracked statues and vine-covered arches. ENVIRONMENT Primeval overgrown jungle landscape with monumental ancient natural formations, dense layered vegetation, colossal trees, tangled roots, mist-filled clearings, hidden stone remnants or forgotten pathways partially reclaimed by nature. Large readable terrain masses first, with deep environmental layering and strong spatial separation between foreground foliage, mid jungle structures, and distant canopy silhouettes. LIGHTING Fresh early-morning jungle illumination with low-angle sunlight filtering through dense canopy gaps in structured directional shafts. Light should clearly define major structural planes while allowing gentle atmospheric mist to separate depth layers and enhance spatial readability without obscuring primary forms. CAMERA Cinematic exploration-style wide establishing shot positioned slightly above ground level as if the viewer has just discovered the scene. Use natural foreground framing through vegetation or terrain forms, clear midground focal anchor, and deep layered jungle distance to reinforce cinematic matte-painting depth construction. MOOD Sense of ancient discovery, untouched history, and quiet natural majesty. The scene should feel like the first reveal of a lost jungle location in a high-budget adventure film or AAA exploration game. DETAIL CONTROL Maintain professional focal-detail hierarchy. Preserve large readable jungle masses first, secondary structural forms next, and apply fine detail only in primary focal regions. Avoid uniform high-frequency foliage noise or excessive micro-detail in distant canopy layers. QUALITY TARGET Ultra-clean studio-grade cinematic jungle environment illustration, portfolio- level concept art readability, strong depth hierarchy, and polished production- ready rendering quality.
